claim.quote: We present the first measurement of pseudorapidity densities of primary charged particles near mid-rapidity in Au+Au collisions at $\sqrt{s} =$ 56 and 130 AGeV.

key_value_text.value: dN/deta (|eta|<1) = 555 ± 12 (stat) ± 35 (syst) at 130 AGeV for the most central collisions

name: PHOBOS first RHIC charged-particle multiplicity measurement

summary.plain: One of the very first RHIC results: PHOBOS counted the charged particles produced near mid-rapidity in the most central gold-gold collisions, finding densities higher than ever seen in nuclear collisions.
summary.technical: First measurement of the pseudorapidity density of primary charged particles near mid-rapidity in Au+Au at 56 and 130 AGeV: dN/deta (|eta|<1) = 408 ± 12 (stat) ± 30 (syst) at 56 AGeV and 555 ± 12 ± 35 at 130 AGeV for the most central collisions, an increase of more than 40% per participant relative to proton-antiproton collisions at the higher energy.

title: Charged particle multiplicity near mid-rapidity in central Au+Au collisions at sqrt(s) = 56 and 130 AGeV
why_it_matters: A first look at the energy density reached at RHIC, which set the scale for the interpretation of all later results.
